sentences.text:
Moumita Murmu @ Bristi Murmu Mandi vs Unknown on 18
September, 2023
18.09.2023 C.R.M. (A) 3698 of 2023
 Ml. 91
Court No. 29
 Nkb
 In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of
 the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Kharagpur
 (Local) Police Station Case No. 617 of 2022 dated 31.07.2022

under Sections 498A, 304B & 34 and adding Section 302 of the
 Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition
 Act, 1961.

And
 In the matter of: Moumita Murmu @ Bristi Murmu Mandi
 ....petitioner.
 Mr. Siddhartha Sarkar
 Mr. Hirak Roy
 ...for the petitioner.

Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, P.P.
 Mr. Aniket Mitra
 Ms. Jonaki Saha
 ...for the State.

1.
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2. Learned Counsel for the petitioner is allowed to make necessary correction in the cause title in Court today.
3. Present petitioner is stated to be the married sister-in-law of the deceased.
Allegation against her is that whenever she used to come to her parental home she used to torture the deceased wife of her brother.
We do not find any proximate relationship between the death of the deceased and the action of the present petitioner.

4. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation and completion of investigation, it is directed that the petitioner shall surrender before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Paschim Medinipur in G.R. Case No. 2387 of 2022 within 15 days from today.

On her surrender and application for bail she shall be released on bail by the aforesaid Court on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and Moumita Murmu @ Bristi Murmu Mandi vs Unknown on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155768505/
